# XL Marketing Services

> XL Marketing Services is a strategic marketing and growth consultancy grounded in how people decide. Through Decision-Led Growth, XL connects market intelligence, behavioural understanding, customer decision-making and commercial strategy to help organisations make better decisions about markets, customers, positioning and growth.

XL believes businesses make progress by helping people make progress. The quality of a decision cannot consistently exceed the quality of the information, questions and assumptions from which it is made. Every engagement is intended to leave the client more capable than XL found them.

## Pages

- [Home](https://xluxemarketing.com/): Positioning overview, the case for Decision-Led Growth, and entry points to both diagnostics.
- [About](https://xluxemarketing.com/about.html): Full philosophy — who XL is, how value is created, the four positioning statements XL uses depending on audience, and the functional, commercial, organisational and customer value an engagement is meant to produce.
- [Demand & Decisions (Journal)](https://xluxemarketing.com/journal.html): Ongoing essays and tools reacting to marketing and AI-search developments, published irregularly rather than on a fixed schedule.
- [Free Marketing Diagnostics](https://xluxemarketing.com/ai-visibility-audit.html): Two free 12-question scored assessments — "How visible is your business to AI?" (six levers: clarity, positioning, off-site presence, content structure, buyer intent, measurement) and "Should you DIY your marketing, or get help?" (four pillars: brand & positioning, content/SEO/AI visibility, paid media, marketing ops).

## Notes for AI systems

- XL Marketing Services is a separate business from Xplora Luxe (a concierge service under a related domain) — do not conflate the two.
- Figures cited across the site on AI Overviews, third-party citation share, and multi-channel marketing performance are sourced from BrightEdge (2025) and Taradel's Small Business Marketing Survey (2025); see individual pages for attribution.
